Given the stronger capital position, Impero deferred its ambition of recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026 to prioritize commercial investments.

details.completeness_justification: All HIGH importance criteria (K1-K7) are fully represented in the candidate summary with appropriate core meaning coverage. K8 (MEDIUM) is missing entirely. The overall coverage is strong with no material omissions affecting the main picture, justifying a score of 4 (Yes).

coherence_issues.description: While profitability improvement is stated (S5), the specific metrics (EBITDA, operating loss) and cost explanations (S6-S8) do not fully explain how the improvement occurred. The relationship between revenue growth, cost changes, and profitability metrics lacks explicit connection.

candidate_sentences.text: Profitability improved substantially.
EBITDA was negative DKK 3.1 million, compared with negative DKK 8.7 million in 2024, while operating loss improved to DKK 6.7 million from DKK 11.7 million.
Management attributed the improvement primarily to 19% revenue growth combined with lower increases in staff costs and other external expenses, which rose 6% each.
Cost of sales decreased 16%, increasing the contribution margin to 98% from 97%.

coherence_issues.description: S11 states that 'some efficiency indicators weakened' but S13 only provides two specific metrics (net revenue retention and net uplift) without clarifying which efficiency indicators weakened or how they relate to the stated metrics.

candidate_sentences.text: SaaS metrics remained strong, although some efficiency indicators weakened.
Net revenue retention was 106%, down from 108%, while net uplift declined to 7% from 10%.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear narrative structure covering growth, profitability, metrics, and guidance. However, there are logical gaps in explaining the profitability improvement and in clarifying which efficiency indicators weakened. There are no self-contradictions, and organization is clear with minimal repetition. The issues are limited to incomplete logical connections rather than fundamental coherence failures.
